# Filter

## Summary
The shared filter verb: predicate builders every list view composes instead of re-deriving. `filterBy(items, ...predicates)` AND-composes and skips holes; `textMatch(needle, ...accessors)` is the case-insensitive "does any field mention this?" every search box wants; `oneOf(allowed, accessor)` is the chip/facet filter where an empty selection means "no filter"; `withinRange(min, max, accessor)` covers numbers and dates with open bounds. The invariant: a filter never throws on a hole — an unloaded link or empty field simply doesn't match.

## Usage
```ts
import filterBy, { textMatch, oneOf } from '@cardstack/catalog/utils/filter';

let visible = filterBy(
  tasks,
  textMatch(query, (t) => t.title, (t) => t.details),
  oneOf(selectedTags, (t) => t.tags?.[0]?.name),
  (t) => t.recordStatus !== 'Archived',
);
```
Three shipped apps re-derived exactly these predicates (P1 list); Quest Log's tag/status task filtering is the first consumer through the block.

**One asymmetry to know.** `textMatch('')` and `oneOf([])` pass everything through — an untouched facet filters nothing. `withinRange(null, null, …)` does NOT: it still excludes items whose accessor yields null or undefined, so an untouched range facet hides unfilled records. Whether that is a bug or the right reading of a range facet is an open call; documented here so it is at least not a surprise.

## Non-goals
Not a query: index-backed filtering belongs to search `filter` expressions (the catalog's index-side surface sits beside `components/sort.gts`, which builds an index `Sort` expression and its picker; this builds predicates over an array already in hand) — this is for lists already in hand, where the two must agree the consumer derives both from one definition (the queue-lens pattern). No OR-composition helper yet — the first real consumer that needs OR names its shape.

**On `specType`.** This is a plain module, not an invokable `Command`. The base `SpecType` enum is card / field / component / app / command and has no slot for a helper module, so `command` is the least wrong value — but anything enumerating command Specs to find something callable will surface this one, and it is not.
attributes.cardDescription: Predicate builders for list views — text match, one-of, within-range — composed by filterBy, where a missing field or unloaded link simply fails to match instead of throwing.
